name: com.gameframex.unity.xcode
description:
GameFrameX XCode — Unity editor tool that configures Xcode projects after iOS builds. Manages Info.plist entries, system frameworks and libraries, build properties, capabilities (in-app purchase, Game Center, push, Sign In with Apple, background modes, iCloud, App Groups, Associated Domains), CocoaPods sources, XcScheme environment variables and launch arguments, localization, file/folder copying, compile flags, and linker flags through declarative JSON config files, with deep merge across multiple config files. Docs: https://gameframex.doc.alianblank.com

GameFrameX XCode — 在 Unity iOS 构建后自动配置 Xcode 项目的编辑器工具。通过 JSON 配置文件声明式管理 Info.plist、系统框架与库、构建属性、Capabilities（内购、Game Center、推送、Sign In with Apple、后台模式、iCloud、App Groups、Associated Domains）、CocoaPods 源、XcScheme 环境变量与启动参数、本地化、文件/文件夹复制、编译标志和链接器标志，并支持多配置文件深度合并。文档：https://gameframex.doc.alianblank.com
